<thought>We need a template that disconnects the N‑S bond of the sulfonamide, i.e., a retrosynthetic step that breaks an N‑S bond and forms a sulfonyl halide (or sulfonic acid) and an amine. Using the valid functional groups list, we can search with “halide” as the broken functional group and “sulfonamides” as the formed functional group, and specify the bond changes (break S‑Cl, form N‑S). This should return a template with its ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1F",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
  "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],
  "bonds_formed": ["N-S"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
